svg.title: Java and Python Enterprise AI: Systems Tiering and Inference Pipeline
svg.desc: Architectural tiering of enterprise AI: Python scientific training and model serialization paired with Java 25 JVM in-process inference, Loom concurrency, and enterprise governance.
